:::{#hero-heading}

*Ph.D. Candidate, Statistics and Operations Research*   
University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

I am a **PhD candidate** in the Statistics and Operations Research (STOR) Department at UNC–Chapel Hill, advised by [Dr. Jan Hannig](https://hannig.cloudapps.unc.edu). My research focuses on developing interpretable statistical frameworks for elite athlete workload monitoring, with the goal of improving player performance and injury prevention.

I also serve as **Principal** of the [Sports Analytics Intelligence Lab (SAIL)](https://supermariogiacomazzo.github.io/sports-analytics-intelligence-laboratory/) at UNC, where I lead projects connecting statistical theory with real-world applications in sports analytics.

Before graduate school, I worked as a software engineer at **Microsoft** and earned dual Bachelor of Science degrees in Mathematics and Computer Science from **Davidson College** (2019).
